summary: Kiwi IRC is a web-based client for Internet Relay Chat networks that runs in standard browsers. It provides a responsive interface and supports custom themes to alter its visual appearance.
goodFor: Deploying a browser-accessible IRC interface for users who want to connect to networks without installing local client software.
watchOut: The project has low maintenance activity, which may result in unpatched security issues or compatibility problems over time.
deployNotes: As a Node.js application, it typically requires a reverse proxy like Nginx or Caddy to handle TLS termination and forward traffic to the local port.
